description: Eli Lilly and Company, incorporated in 1901 in Indiana to succeed to the drug manufacturing business founded in Indianapolis in 1876 by Colonel Eli Lilly, discovers, develops, manufactures and markets human pharmaceutical products in a single business segment, with a purpose to unite caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. It manufactures and distributes its products through facilities in the United States, including Puerto Rico, and in Europe and Asia, and its products are sold in approximately 90 countries. Its long-term success depends on its ability to continually discover or acquire, develop and commercialize innovative medicines, with a portfolio that includes cardiometabolic health products such as Basaglar, Humalog and Trulicity, and obesity and sleep apnea treatments including Zepbound.
